sections.content: Style a complete multi-section page: hero, features grid, testimonials, pricing table, footer — fully responsive from 320px to 4K, keyboard-navigable, dark-mode aware.
Requirements: CSS custom properties for all colors/spacing, Grid for page layout, Flexbox for components, hover/focus/active states on everything interactive, zero horizontal scroll, Lighthouse >90.
Key points: mobile-first breakpoints, test with real content, not filler copy, and reduced-motion support is mandatory.
